name: pulse-streak
description: Pulse Streak — one-tap endless runner for kids (Phaser 3, single-file build)

scripts.check: node -e "require('./tests/harness').loadGame().boot(); console.log('index.html parses, evaluates and boots clean')"
scripts.android:add: npm run build:www && npx cap add android && npm run android:patch
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && npm run version:sync && npm run icons
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.release:preflight: npm test && npm run check && npm run version:check
